completion_gates: Reconcile source anchors with public.source_authorities before adding or updating rows; do not duplicate authority anchors.
Review each URL and scope; entries with url=null are provider-specific and must be discovered from an authoritative source, never guessed.
Import source observations idempotently with retrieved_at, verifier, evidence URL, confidence, expiry and NEEDS_REVIEW defaults.
Do not activate candidate-facing claims or connectors until the relevant exact record has passed its own verification gate.
Test sector search, source freshness, duplicate and alias handling, Candidate A/B isolation, RLS, audit, retries and human-review queues.
Apply migrations only after independent review, approved change control, backup/restore evidence and post-migration security checks.
